newsitem.title: USA: California unemployment rate unchanged at 6.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: California unemployment rate unchanged at 6.8 pct.

text.p: California's unemployment rate was unchanged at 6.8 percent in January, according to a state report Friday.
The number of people employed in California increased by 88,000 over the month and rose 368,000 compared with year ago figures, the state Employment Development Department reported.

"Not even the most optimistic economic forecasters would have predicted a year ago that we would see 400,000 new jobs created over 12 months," Gov. Pete Wilson said in a statement. "The results have clearly surpassed our best expectations."
Motion picture production added 24,800 jobs in the state since January of 1996, a 23.3 percent increase.
The construction industry gained 7,400 jobs in January and 34,000 over the past 12 months, the Employment Development Department reported.
